notes.title: 🎮 Gamepad support added 🎮
notes.content:
Battlegrounds2D now supports gamepad input devices.
Therefore it should be ready to be played on Steam Deck.

notes.title: Battlegrounds2D.IO Has Officially Left Early Access
notes.content:
Battlegrounds2D.IO has left Early Access.🎉🎉

It is now a singleplayer game.
You can fight against bots offline.

Have Fun & Happy Fragging

notes.title: Server issues
notes.content:
We had some server issues the last days.
Sorry for that.
This issue is fixed and they are up and running again.

notes.title: We are live! 🎉🎉🎉

notes.title: Release: 22th February 2019!
notes.content:
